---
name: draft-reply
description: "Draft a reply to an inbound message for the principal to review; never send it."
---

Draft a reply that answers the sender's question, names any commitment that
still needs the principal's approval, and ends with the open questions. Mark
the result as a draft; do not send it or imply that it was sent.

## Context

### Reply style

Replies are short, lead with the answer, and use the sender's own terms for
dates and owners.
